Module net.automatalib.api
Package net.automatalib.automaton.mmlt

Interface MutableMMLT<S,I,T,O>

Type Parameters:
S - location type
I - input symbol type (of non-delaying inputs)
T - transition type
O - output symbol type

public interface MutableMMLT<S,I,T,O> extends MMLT<S,I,T,O>, MutableDeterministic<S,I,T,Void,O>
A mutable extension of MMLT that allows for modifying transition structure and timers.

  • Method Details

    • addPeriodicTimer

      void addPeriodicTimer(S location, String name, long initial, List<O> outputs)
      Adds a new periodic timer to the provided location. Throws an error if
      • the outputs are empty, contain silence, or combined output symbols,
      • the initial value is less zero or less,
      • the initial value exceeds that of a one-shot timer (-> timer never expires),
      • the timer will time out at the same time as a one-shot timer.
      Parameters:
      location - the location of the timer
      name - the timer name
      initial - the initial value
      outputs - the outputs at timeout

    • addPeriodicTimer

    • addOneShotTimer

      void addOneShotTimer(S location, String name, long initial, List<O> outputs, S target)
      Adds a new one-shot timer to the provided location. Removes all timers of that location with higher initial value, as these can no longer time out. Throws an error if
      • the outputs are empty or contain silence, or combined output symbols,
      • the initial value is less zero or less,
      • the initial value exceeds that of a one-shot timer (-> timer never expires),
      • the timer will time out at the same time as a periodic timer.
      Parameters:
      location - the location of the timer
      name - the timer name
      initial - the initial value
      outputs - the outputs at timeout
      target - the target location when timing out

      void removeTimer(S location, String timerName)

      Parameters:

      timerName - the name of the timer

    • addLocalReset

      void addLocalReset(S location, I input)
      Adds a local reset at the provided input in the provided location. Throws an error if the transition does not self-loop.
      Parameters:
      location - the source location
      input - the input of the transition that should perform a local reset

    • removeLocalReset

      void removeLocalReset(S location, I input)
      Removes a local reset at the provided input in the provided location. No effect if the input does not trigger a local reset.
      Parameters:
      location - the source location
      input - the input of the transition that performs a local reset.
